title: The Chemical Drain Cleaner Myth
description: Many property owners believe that pouring harsh chemical drain cleaners down a slow pipe is a quick and safe fix for clogs. In professional plumbing practice, however, these products often cause more harm than good. Liquid chemical drain cleaners generate high heat through chemical reactions, which can warp plastic piping or degrade old metal lines. Furthermore, when these chemicals fail to clear a stubborn obstruction, they remain trapped in the standing water, creating a severe chemical hazard for the service technician who eventually has to open the trap or clear the line mechanically. Professional plumbers rely on mechanical clearing tools, such as drain snakes or hydro jetting, to safely remove blockages without damaging the drainage infrastructure.

The Chemical Drain Cleaner Myth

Many property owners believe that pouring harsh chemical drain cleaners down a slow pipe is a quick and safe fix for clogs. In professional plumbing practice, however, these products often cause more harm than good. Liquid chemical drain cleaners generate high heat through chemical reactions, which can warp plastic piping or degrade old metal lines. Furthermore, when these chemicals fail to clear a stubborn obstruction, they remain trapped in the standing water, creating a severe chemical hazard for the service technician who eventually has to open the trap or clear the line mechanically. Professional plumbers rely on mechanical clearing tools, such as drain snakes or hydro jetting, to safely remove blockages without damaging the drainage infrastructure.
